proposal.mechanism: Split current PV CTA into64producer threads and192consumer threads. Keep same grid,64position tiles, four physical buffers, six head warps and two ordered accumulators per lane. Producers independently acquire free stages, copy original V/P operands and publish completion; consumers wait for a produced stage, perform unchanged ascending-position FP32 FMAs and release it after all readers retire.
invariants: Same per-row causal range andFP32probability; no padding operand consumed.
No FMA reassociation, split position sum, BF16 boundary change, target state change or extra request allocation.
Every stage reused only after all192consumers release; all64producers commit at a converged boundary.
Tail commits and waits have identical counts across participating roles; no early thread exit before pipeline drain.
